scope.summary: Author the dedup-mapping validation that records every Figma-origin composite effect resolves to its normative Studio home and is neither lost nor double-counted: Drop/Inner shadow -> Layer FX (MT-287); Layer blur -> Gaussian Blur (MT-266); Progressive blur / Background blur -> Blur GPU (MT-267); Noise -> Add Noise (MT-270); Texture -> Distort Texture (MT-269); Glass -> Distort refractive Glass (MT-269); Effect styles -> Effect Styles registry (MT-300). A StudioValidationDescriptor check asserts no Figma effect maps to a missing/duplicate home.
acceptance_criteria: all group-15 Figma-origin effects map to one existing Studio home; dedup validation passes (no loss, no double-count)
expected_tests: test: each Figma-origin effect (drop/inner shadow, layer/progressive/background blur, noise, texture, glass, effect styles) maps to exactly one implemented Studio home; no orphan/duplicate

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Figma effects silently lost or double-counted; parity claim unverifiable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
